chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr and Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about what people say regarding the bequest of one-third and one-fourth at the time of his death: is it something correct and well-known, or how did your father do?
He said: “One-third — that is what my father عليه السلام did.”

key_terms.صَحِيحٌ: sound or correct in legal and recognized practice
key_terms.مَوْتِهِ: the time of death when the bequest is being considered
key_terms.ٱلثُّلُثِ: one-third of the estate mentioned as the practiced measure
key_terms.ٱلرُّبُعِ: one-fourth of the estate, mentioned as part of the question
key_terms.ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ: bequest or testamentary instruction made before death

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about bequeathing one-third of one’s wealth at death?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of making a bequest near death and clarifies the recognized measure through the practice of the Imam’s father عليه السلام. The reply indicates that one-third is the established amount referred to in this context.
